questions.question: If 5 May 1911 is Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 11 September 1919?
questions.solution:
Given: **5 May 1911** was Friday.

Now,

1911 to 1919 = 8 Years (6 Ordinary Year and 2 Leap Year).

And, In 8 Years = 2 Leap years and 6 Ordinary Year.

So, 2 Leap Year has 4 odd days,

And, 6 Ordinary Year has 6 odd days.

Total odd days = 4 + 6 = 10.

10 odd days → 10/7 = 1 week and 3 odd days.

then, 5 May 1919 will be Friday + 3 = Monday.

Now, the number of days between 5 May 1911 to 11 September 1919

= 26(May) + 30(June) + 31(July) + 31(August) + 11(September) = 129 days.

= 129 days → 129/7 = 18 week and 3 odd day.

So, 11 **September **1919 will be Monday + 3 = **Thursday**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question: Which of the following diseases is a potential contender for worldwide eradication?

• **Polio** is a potential contender for **worldwide eradication** because it is a **vaccine-preventable disease** and there are effective vaccines available.
 
• The **World Health Organization **(WHO) has been leading the global effort to **eradicate polio **since **1988,** and significant progress has been made in reducing the number of cases worldwide.
 
• **Tuberculosis, measles, and malaria** are not currently considered potential contenders for worldwide eradication because they are more difficult to **control and eliminate** due to various factors such as **drug resistance, lack of effective vaccines,** and **complex transmission patterns.**
 
• However, efforts are still being made to reduce the burden of these diseases through various strategies such as **improved diagnostics, treatment, and prevention measures.**

• **Tuberculosis** is a** bacterial infection** that primarily affects the **lungs** but can also affect other parts of the body.

 
 
• It is a major cause of** illness** and **death** worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Measles** is a highly contagious** viral **infection.
 
 
• It can cause serious complications such as** pneumonia, brain damage, and death,** and it is still a major cause of death among young children in many parts of the world.
 
 
 
• **Malaria** is a parasitic infection that is transmitted by **mosquitoes**, and it can cause **fever, chills, and flu-like symptoms**, and in severe cases, it can lead to organ failure and death.
 
 
• It is a major public health problem in many **tropical and subtropical **regions of the world.

questions.question: Due to which of the following reasons can money be differentiated from other physical assets that can perform the function of store of value?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Money is easy to store.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Money **can be differentiated from other **physical assets** that can perform the function of store of value due to the following reasons:
 
• **Easy to store**:
 
 
• Money can be stored in a variety of forms, including **cash, bank deposits, or digital wallets**.
 
• It does not require any **specialized storage** or maintenance.
 
• Other physical assets like** real estate or art **may require specialized storage **facilities and maintenance.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Liquidity:** 

 
 
• Money is **highly liquid **and can be easily converted into cash without any loss in its value. 
 
• Other physical assets like **real estate or gold** may have a high store of value but may not be easily convertible into cash.
 
 
 
• **Common acceptability:** 
 
 
• Money is universally accepted and recognized as a** medium of exchange**. 
 
• It is accepted by all parties in a** transaction**, making it easier to conduct **trade and commerce.** 
 
• Other physical assets** may not** have the same level of acceptance.
 
 
 
• **Neutral:**
 
 
• Money is neutral and **does not **carry any emotional or personal attachment. 
 
• It is a standardized form of currency that is free from any **personal biases or opinions**.
 
• Other physical assets may have** sentimental value **attached to them.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT the reason why 'final' goods are called so?

• This is a** correct reason** why final goods are called so.
 
• Final goods are ready for** use or sale** and do not require any further processing or transformation.
 
 
 
• They are not** processed or transformed** further.
 
 
• This is a** correct reason** why final goods are called so.
 
• Final goods are the **end products **of the production process and do not require any further processing or transformation.

• They are the end products of the production process and are ready for **use or sale** in the market.
 
• Final goods are different from i**ntermediate goods,** which are used as raw materials or components in the production of final goods.

questions.question: The cost of 3 cups and 5 plates is ₹1,080 and the cost of 2 cups and 4 plates is ₹840. Find the ratio of the cost of a cup to the cost of a plate.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

2 Cups + 4 Plates = 840 → 1 Cup + 2 Plates = 420.

Multiply by 3 ⇒ 3 Cups + 6 Plates = 1260.

Difference with (3 Cups + 5 Plates = 1080) ⇒ 1 Plate = 1260 − 1080 = 180.

Cost of 1 Cup = 420 − (2 × 180) = 420 − 360 = 60.

Ratio of Cup to Plate = 60 : 180 = 1 : 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 ∶ 3.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost of 3 cups and 5 plates = ₹1,080

Cost of 2 cups and 4 plates = ₹840

Simultaneous Linear Equations: a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂
